newsitem.title: UK: London shares close higher, market remains nervous.
newsitem.headline: London shares close higher, market remains nervous.

text.p: Leading UK shares finished higher for the sixth straight day on Tuesday but volumes remained light as investors continued to fret about politics and interest rates.
The FTSE's advance was patchy, relying on strong gains in pharmaceuticals, oils, and banks to offset a broad decline in most other sectors.
"The drugs and the oils really saved the day," one senior dealer said. "Otherwise, there wasn't much to get too excited about."
The FTSE 100 closed 17.4 points higher at 4,346.1.
